# P30.2b — Geospatial camera-site entity resolution (GO-LIVE.2b)

Implements `docs/tickets/P30.2b__geospatial-camera-site-resolution.md` (inserted 2026-09-24, operator: "Fix
resolution first, then launch"). Stacked on `devin/p30-2a-camera-predicate-registry` (`84597f1`). Decision:
**ADR-105**. Requirement ids: SIG-IDENT-020/023/024/025/027/028/029, SIG-RECON-001/002, SIG-METRIC-008/009/010,
SIG-GEO-009, SIG-STORE-012.

## Summary

After P30.2a, every hosted camera record had a value-resolved coordinate — and `resolved_sites_metric` counted
that as "resolved sites (deduplicated from observations)", so P30.3 would have published **N ≈ M = 230,330**.
That is value resolution within one source's record, not deduplication. This PR makes a **resolved site** a
measured post-ER cluster of observation-level records judged to be the **same physical device** (M records,
N clusters, N ≤ M, dedup ratio 1 − N/M), builds the geospatial ER to produce it, gates auto-merges on a
measured holdout, runs it in GCP, and redefines the metric over the result.

**Hosted result (reviewed code): M 230,330 → N 227,998, dedup ratio 0.0101** — 2,332 same-device merges, all
from rules whose strict holdout precision cleared 0.98; 11,235 uncertain candidates proposed to human review and
not counted. Small and honest: most records have no cross-source counterpart.

## What changed

- **Unit + metric**: `exports.spine_export.resolved_site_counts` / `resolved_sites_metric` read the latest
  COMPLETED camera-site run's auto-written edges (new read seam `camera_sites_pg.read_resolved_site_runs`):
  "N resolved sites (from M observation-level records; dedup ratio r)", denominated in M, with the
  auto-written / proposed counts + the PROVISIONAL disclosure. No run → `None` (observation framing stays).
  A §28 value decision is never counted (test-pinned). Map layer copy follows; points stay one record's own.
- **Blocking**: `[[geo_rule]] camera_geo_grid` + `blocking.GeoGridRule` — same/neighbouring cell, different
  source, cell proven to cover the 50 m radius to |lat| 73°, sized against the 1,000,000 ceiling (hosted 30,360).
- **Matcher** `resolution/camera_sites.py` + `data/camera_site_rules.toml` (v2): tiers 1g shared upstream ref
  / 3g coincident point (candidate auto-write) / 4g, 5g proximate (always review); device classes; soft
  conflicts (jurisdiction, type, direction); mirror-lineage inference; constrained clustering (no two records
  of one source — transitively; span ≤ 50 m; ≤ 6); cluster-shape alerts (chain, oversized, single bridge,
  same source) demote to review; `representative_point` (both axes from one record); run key over every
  decision input.
- **Eval (ADR-099 loop)**: gold set `camera-2` (`data/camera_site_gold.json`, coordinate-free, 540
  double-adjudicated pairs, stratified by tier × {cross-source mirror, dense urban, highway corridor, rural
  singleton, other}); strict per-tier precision on the frozen agent-verified holdout, ≥ 50 pairs per tier,
  Wilson bounds, LLM-label sensitivity; disputed pairs enqueued for review.
- **Storage** sqitch `camera_site_resolution`: append-only `camera_site_match` + `camera_site_run` (completion
  marker, N ≤ M CHECK); `sig_materialize` INSERT-only on them + `review_item`.
- **Ops/CLI**: `python -m resolution camera-sites --dsn … --role … [--dry-run]`; `materialize.sh` step
  `camera-sites`.
- **Report/copy**: eval report regenerated from `docs/build/reports/p30.2b-hosted/resolution_scale.json`
  (new camera-site section); methodology page defines the unit + publishes the camera-site eval figures.
- ADR-105, BL-057, Appendix F (+ rebuilt spec), ADR index, DEFERRALS (D-P30.2-3 closed; D-P30.2b-1/-2/-3
  opened), run ledger `docs/build/runs/P30.2b.md`.

## The measured eval (and what was done to keep it honest)

| | |
|---|---|
| gold | `camera-2`: 540 pairs; agent/maintainer seed (verifier) + an LLM adjudicator in a fresh context that saw only the written rules and the evidence sheet; both blind to the matcher's tier |
| κ (LLM vs agent) | **0.669** over 540 (0.667 on the holdout) — **below the 0.70 bar → LLM is a suggester only**; 77 disputed pairs → review |
| v1 rules | holdout: 1g 0.882, 3g 0.929 → both demoted (nothing would auto-write). The holdout was then inspected while diagnosing → **retired to training** |
| v2 rules | derived from training-partition errors only; measured once on a **fresh 180-pair holdout**: **1g 70/70 = 1.000** (Wilson 95% lower 0.948), **3g 69/70 = 0.986** (lower 0.923), 4g 0.300, 5g 0.263 |
| gate | strict precision (NEI counts against), ≥ 50 holdout pairs, floor 0.98 → **auto-write tiers 1g, 3g** |
| sensitivity | under the LLM's labels 3g would be 0.800 (it reads sub-metre offsets between republished copies as "proximity only") — disclosed; D-R6.1-EVAL stays OPEN |
| alerts | 0 cluster-shape alerts on the hosted run |

## What P30.3 may publish

> **227,998 resolved sites (from 230,330 observation-level records; dedup ratio 0.010)** — a resolved site is a
> cluster of records judged to describe the same physical device; 2,332 same-device merges were auto-written
> (only rules whose measured holdout precision cleared the published floor); proposed merges await human review
> and are not counted. Resolution rests on a provisional eval (LLM-bootstrapped gold set; D-R6.1-EVAL, OPEN).

(The export computes N over its own published sites, so the figure P30.3 prints is the export's; never
"230,330 resolved sites".)

## Deferrals

- **Closed:** D-P30.2-3 (both halves done).
- **Opened (BL-057):** D-P30.2b-1 (review decisions → clustering + gold growth), D-P30.2b-2 (name-level
  device-kind / place conflicts, seen only in the retired v1 holdout), D-P30.2b-3 (a source republishing its
  own layer twice).
- **Still OPEN:** D-R6.1-EVAL first-principles half (PROVISIONAL disclosure kept); D-P30.2a-1/-2 untouched.

## Deviations

- Operator conflicts are handled as recorded device-class rules + soft conflicts, because published operator
  labels are per-publisher (a republisher's name), not the device owner (ADR-105 §4).
- Clusters are a separate append-only decision layer; entities are never merged or updated (ADR-105
  alternatives).
- The v1 holdout was inspected and retired; v2 measured on a fresh holdout (disclosed in the gold file,
  report and ADR).
